src_sentence: In 1865, the US postal service was seen as a "vehicle" for the transmission of materials that were deemed obscene by the American lawmakers.

src_sentence: Beginning in the 21st century, greater access to the Internet and affordable smartphones made pornography more mainstream.

src_sentence: One of the world's leading anti-pornography campaigners, Gail Dines, has stated that "the demand for porn has driven the development of core cross-platform technologies for data compression, search, transmission and micro-payments."
translation: Una de las principales activistas contra la pornografía del mundo, Gail Dines, ha declarado que "la demanda de pornografía ha impulsado el desarrollo de tecnologías multiplataforma centrales para la Compresión de datos, Motor de búsqueda, Transmisión de datos y micropagos".
